sentences.text: Lodged against the petitioner herein namely Suresh Gupta must be tried along with the case titled as Food Safety Officer vs Suresh Gupta., bearing Ct. No. 3122/2023 pending in the Hon'ble Court of Sh. Pranav Joshi, Ld. ACJM, New-Delhi, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi for 17.11.2025 for miscellaneous appearance; and/or B. Pass any such other and further order/direction, which this Hon'ble court deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present case."

entities.text: Food Safety Officer vs Suresh Gupta
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. The aforenoted two cases, one registered by the Delhi Police and the other one by the Food Safety Officer arise from the same raid conducted at the premises of the Petitioner, which resulted in recovery of approximately 28 tons of Faux Cumin Seeds.

Pursuant to the said raid, FIR No.
244/2022 was registered at P.S. Crime Branch, North West District, at the instance of the State Police.

entities.text: P.S. Crime Branch, North West District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In the said, FIR a chargesheet was filed for the offences under Sections 272, 273, 308, 420 and 511 of the Indian Penal Code, 18602 read with Section 3(l)(ZZ) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Subsequently, on 12th September, 2023, the Food Safety Officer also instituted a complaint under Sections 3, 26, 59(i) and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006 against the Petitioner.
3. Having regard to the fact that both proceedings emanate from the same incident, this Court is of the opinion that it would be appropriate that they be tried before the same Presiding Officer.

It is noted that the complaint filed by the Food Safety Officer titled 'Food Safety Officer v Suresh Gupta',
bearing Ct. No. 3122/2023 is pending before the Court of the ACJ, New Delhi, Patiala House Courts.

arising out of FIR No. 244/2022, bearing CR Case No. 7322/2023.
4.
